title: Smart Hawker
simplified_paragraphs: 有一个人去买牛奶，小贩说：”三元一杯，十元三杯。”
他拿三块钱买了一杯，像这样买了三次，然后对小贩说：”你看，我拿九块钱就买了三杯。”
小贩说：”我这么做，每次都能卖出三杯。”
traditional_paragraphs: 有一個人去買牛奶，小販說：”三元一杯，十元三杯。”
他拿三塊錢買了一杯，像這樣買了三次，然後對小販說：”你看，我拿九塊錢就買了三杯。”
小販說：”我這麼做，每次都能賣出三杯。”
pinyin_paragraphs: yǒu yī gè rén qù mǎi niú nǎi， xiǎo fàn shuō：” sān yuán yī bēi， shí yuán sān bēi。”
tā ná sān kuài qián mǎi le yī bēi， xiàng zhè yàng mǎi le sān cì， rán hòu duì xiǎo fàn shuō：” nǐ kàn， wǒ ná jiǔ kuài qián jiù mǎi le sān bēi。”
xiǎo fàn shuō：” wǒ zhè me zuò， měi cì dōu néng mài chū sān bēi。”
english_paragraphs: A man went to buy some milk. The vendor said, “Three yuan a cup, or ten yuan for three cups.”
The man paid three yuan for a cup and did the same thing two more times. Then he said to the vendor, “See? I got three cups for just nine yuan.”
The vendor said, “When I price it this way, I sell three cups every time.”
english_full:
A man went to buy some milk. The vendor said, “Three yuan a cup, or ten yuan for three cups.”

The man paid three yuan for a cup and did the same thing two more times. Then he said to the vendor, “See? I got three cups for just nine yuan.”

The vendor said, “When I price it this way, I sell three cups every time.”
